content.comment_body: I'm trying to program a [article_no] module using [product_name] version 8.0, but it's not working. Is it possible I need version 8.1? The connection appears fine – it shows as 'green/ok' (see attached image). However, when attempting to download, run, stop, or perform online testing, nothing happens and I receive no error messages. PC IP: 192.168.0.1 Device IP: 192.168.0.3

You need at least [product_name] version 8.1. If you want to use the advanced web server in [product_name] version 8.2, you'll require version 8.2 of the software. You can download everything from the link I posted earlier in your thread. How do I update from 8.0 to 8.1? The [product_name] version 8.2 appears as [product_name] FS4 in hardware selection.
You require [product_name] version 8.2. The download is free if you already have a full version license. [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience compatibility problems between [product_name] version 8.0 and specific hardware, resulting in inability to program devices even when connections seem successful. The absence of error messages makes troubleshooting more difficult and delays resolving the issue.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to allow complete programming, control, and diagnosis on their hardware whenever communication is established. They also look for clear feedback or instructions from the software when issues disrupt normal operation.
